network_enforcement: The checker makes no network request and delegates the fresh Lean replay to check_validation.sh, whose Lean subprocesses run at --trust=0 inside bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root. The automation-provided pinned .lake artifacts are reused read-only, so this remains warm nonrelease evidence rather than a cold hermetic release run.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: Worker-side negative release reconciliation plus a current network-isolated trust-zero replay of the exact proof and validation declarations. It cannot provide dependency or master acceptance, accepted H0/R0 or complete trust closure, immutable clean input, cold empty-cache build, offline restoration, complete SBOM/licenses, two independent signed runners, an independently implemented verifier, protected release CI, or a deterministic release bundle.
